summary: Completed bounded round44 provider overlay, confirmation and touch-control mismatches; preserved accepted shell/runtime and current dark-only navigation. Mobile tool recheck remains an evidenced design-location decision, not claimed complete.

changes.implementation: Mobile provider key/address editing now uses the existing kit Sheet instead of an inline editor. Desktop retains its inline form and both invoke the same updateProvider action. Key field is46px with16px text and44px reveal control; address uses the kit mobile field. Submission has an in-flight guard and pending state.

Provider removal waits for edit Sheet.onExited before opening confirm. Choosing an already-connected provider from the add sheet likewise waits for add Sheet.onExited before opening the key sheet. No simultaneous edit/add/confirm layers are introduced.

Removed the hardcoded OpenRouter fallback from the shared provider logout API/caller. Shared Vietnamese confirmation describes machine-wide credentials, new calls, potentially finishing submitted images, conditional existing fallback and preserved output. Success only confirms logout; it no longer falsely declares the artist switched providers. Existing logoutProvider endpoint is unchanged.

Mobile unsaved-model Save/Cancel actions now use44px lg controls. Provider login/edit/logout and connection-test failures plus the tools-load failure render Vietnamese product errors instead of raw exception/test error text.
